Quakeworld clan

== History ==
Was founded by [[Raket]] and [[Aikon]] in autumn of 2014 for the European Quakeworld League.
After 020 played for a while [[Aikon]] started 0200 with a lineup of Lurq, z0det, z0mbie, pew. After some time 0200 was abandoned and 020 let some players from 0200 to join 020.
